applies_to: Regin Presigo PDTN one- and two-channel differential pressure transmitters with display, firmware 1.1-1-00.
summary: PDTN measures one or two differential pressures and can calculate airflow from them (K-factor formulas). Over RS485 it speaks EXOline, Modbus or BACnet MS/TP. The variable list gives 91 BACnet objects: pressure and flow per channel, range/unit/formula settings, zero calibration, analogue output values with comm-loss defaults, and display settings.
notes: Taken from Regin's variable list (xlsx), "Default BACnet name", "Object type", "Instance", "Unit" and "Writeable" columns; the same file lists the EXOline and Modbus addresses.

Names follow the variable list's "Default BACnet name" column. Regin's EDE file for 1.1-1-00 uses other, upper-case names (for example AO1_VALUE for AV 1201 Output_Channel_1_value) and puts most PS1/PS2 settings on the same instance (10000), so it can't be used as an object list.
AV 10002/10003 pressures are in the unit set by MV 10003/10004; flows follow MV 10005/10006.
Multistate state texts come from the EDE file where the object could be matched by name.

integration.summary: Read AV 10002 PS_1_pressure (and AV 10003 for channel 2) or the calculated flows AV 10004 / AV 10005. Set the units, range and flow formula once at commissioning.
setup: Port 1 (RS485) protocol, baud rate and format are MV 9001 / 9101 / 9201; write BV 9001 CommCommit = 1 to apply them.
BV 10001 / BV 10002 PS_x_set_zero run a zero calibration when written to 1.
gotchas: Range, unit and formula objects are configuration; do not write them cyclically.
